author: Haley Bird
capability_gap: No existing tool tracks, against a local archive of already-claimed structural classes, whether a scientific unknown is a missing place, converter, clock, join, mixed number, hidden field, wrong generator, wrong constitutive sense — or a published interval that already contains two qualitative worlds while the working sentence cites one number.
class_one_liner: A published number's interval contains more than one qualitative world, and the working sentence cites the point estimate as if it contained one.

falsification_rule.case_kill_modal: If the source already leads with the interval and the claim is modal, IRC does not apply.
falsification_rule.class_kill: If both ends of the interval license the same qualitative sentence, IRC does not apply.
falsification_rule.graduation: If a better census of the SAME generator shrinks the interval until both ends agree, the case leaves IRC.
falsification_rule.not_efc: Swapping generators is EFC. Shrinking one number is IRC.
falsification_rule.not_oac: Unmixing two aliased quantities is OAC. One quantity, two worlds is IRC.
falsification_rule.not_tac: Locating a converter does not close an interval-reversal.
falsification_rule.not_undersampling: More spatial samples at the same precision that do not shrink the qualitative split → still IRC or EFC, not a missing place.
